resources.string: Lets JARVIS read and act in the app in front when a task you started asks it to, only for apps you have allowed in the per-app grid. Password fields are never read or typed into. Nothing read from the screen is stored.
This task needs Shizuku. Open Shizuku and start it (after a reboot, pair wireless debugging again), then allow JARVIS. The task will continue once it is back.
This task needs JARVIS screen reading. Turn it on in Settings › Accessibility.
This task needs notification access. Allow JARVIS in Settings › Notification access.
Screenshots need Android 11 or newer and JARVIS screen reading turned on.
On-device text recognition is not available on this phone.
